info.title: Saka control API
info.description: Local control API of a Saka server.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: One or more of `asked, answered, delivered, expired`, comma-separated.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Only this project's `project`, `project_repo`, and `repo` checks; instance, agent account, and integration checks always run.

parameters.name: check
parameters.description: A check id from the catalog, for example `agent.login`; repeat for more. Without it, every check runs.

Cache-Control.description: Always `no-store`: every request runs the checks again.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Start after this `seq` (`Last-Event-ID` wins when both are given).

200.description: One `data` per event, `id` = seq. `runtime.session.activity.v1` messages carry an ActivityNotice and no `id`.

ETag.description: A digest of the page; send it back as If-None-Match
A digest of the summary; send it back as If-None-Match

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: One or more of `pending, allowed, denied, expired`, comma-separated.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: `policy` (answered by a rule) or `human` (answered by the operator).

200.description: The mode in force; setting the current mode again records nothing
The token is checked and stored; its value is never returned

204.description: The token is gone, or there was none

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the file relative to the workspace repo root, inside the project folder.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the file relative to the workspace repo root, inside the project folder.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: "<blob>" of the file being replaced, or * for any existing file

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: * to create a file that must not exist yet

200.description: An existing file, changed or already equal

204.description: The secret is gone, or never existed

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: `active` (default: queued, preparing, drafting, committing, failed), `finished` (succeeded, cancelled), or `all`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: One or more of `draft, ready, approved, shipped, withdrawn`, comma-separated.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Only the spec registered at exactly this path (at most 1024 bytes).

404.description: `not_found` for an unknown integration, `user_link_not_found` without a linked account

204.description: The link is gone, or there was none; the tokens are not revoked at the provider

202.description: A pending authorization: a new one, or the one still pending with more than a minute left

parameters.name: work_item_id
parameters.description: Without `active=true`, exactly one of `work_item_id` and `spec_draft_id` is required.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: `true` lists the sessions that are not over, across projects, newest first; exclusive with the run filters.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return the activities right after this offset. At most one of `after`, `before`, and `tail`.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return the activities right before this offset, still in ascending order.

parameters.name: tail
parameters.description: `true` returns the last `limit` activities, in ascending order.

parameters.name: work_item_id
parameters.description: One of `work_item_id`, `spec_draft_id`, and `session_id` is required; `work_item_id` and `spec_draft_id` are exclusive.

last_activity_at.description: The time of the last recorded activity; `started_at` when there is none yet.

role.description: The stage of the owning run (`dev`, `review`, `fix`, `merge`, `sync`) or `architect` for a draft.

started_at.description: When the session started; the creation time while it is still `starting`.

title.description: The task key, or the slug of the draft.

ActivityNotice.description: The `data` of a `runtime.session.activity.v1` SSE message: a new timeline row to read with the timeline cursor.

paused.description: A window is at or above `agent.rate_limit_pause` and has not reset; new tasks wait.

remember.description: With `allow` only: also allow the same tool (and, for Bash, the same whole command) in this project from now on.

option.description: Index into `options`. At least one of `option` and `note` is required.

AuthStatus.description: Whether the server asks for credentials and who the caller is.

setup_required.description: No passkey is registered yet: the first one needs a `setup` code from the host.

AuthorshipIntegration.description: An integration of a project and the state of its linked account.

credential.description: The credential the browser returned, in the JSON form of the WebAuthn spec.

CeremonyStarted.description: A WebAuthn ceremony the server holds in memory for five minutes. It can be finished once.

options.description: The WebAuthn options for `navigator.credentials.create` or `.get`, in the JSON form of the WebAuthn spec.

base_branch.description: `null` = the default branch of the workspace repo.

content.description: The `saka.toml` text to check, 1 to 65 536 bytes.

project_path.description: `.` for the repo root, or a relative folder path; same rules as `POST /projects`.

workspace_url.description: HTTPS URL of the repo that holds the project folder; same rules as `POST /projects`.

CheckedProject.description: The project already registered for this workspace repo and folder.

CheckedRepo.description: A `[[repo]]` binding that resolved; same shape as `Project.repos[]` without ids.

effective_path_scope.description: `path_scope`, plus `<project_path>/**` for the workspace repo unless `project_path` is `.`.

CheckedWorkspace.description: The workspace repo as the check resolved it.

base_branch.description: The effective base branch: the requested one, or the default branch.

message.description: 1 to 200 characters; the docs commit message. Defaults to the usual one.

ConfigCheck.description: Result of checking a `saka.toml` without registering it.

problems.description: In order: content issues, the workspace, then repos in `[[repo]]` order.

oneOf.description: `null` when no project is registered for this workspace repo and folder.
`null` when `workspace` is `null` or its base branch does not exist.

repos.description: Resolved bindings, default first, then by `name`.

oneOf.description: `null` when the workspace host has no integration or the App cannot read the repo.

ConfigProblem.description: A problem that would refuse registration.

line.description: Line of the first link in the spec; `1` for `always`.

origin.description: `link` (linked from the spec) or `always` (marked `context: always` in the project folder).

path.description: Path relative to the workspace repo root.

context_paths.description: Up to 16 distinct docs in the project folder the architect reads first.

idea.description: 1 to 8000 characters after trimming; stored as written.

locale.description: `en` (default) or `id`: the template and the language of the prose.

path.description: The new spec file from the repo root, inside the project folder, ending in `.md`.

target_kind.description: `new` (default) or `revise`: `revise` needs `path` to exist on the base branch.

option.description: Index into `options`; 0 is the agent's recommendation. Null when only a note was given.

DecisionOrigin.description: Who decided: `builtin`, `rule` (operator config), `project` (a project rule, `name` is its id), `default` (nothing matched, so ask).

kind.description: `local_cli` is the token of the CLI on the host; it cannot be revoked.

code.description: What was found; the client turns it and `params` into text. Never holds a token, key, secret, or account email.

oneOf.description: `null` for `pass` and `skip`.

params.description: `command` holds the command that fixes it, when there is one.

mode.description: `online` from the server; `saka doctor` writes `offline` when it ran the local checks itself.

id.description: For example `instance`, `claude:default`, or an integration, repo, or project id.

skipped.description: `true` when it was closed without merge and the task went on without it.

base_sha.description: The commit the checkout started at.

branch.description: The docs branch of a `writable` checkout; `null` when `read_only`.

commit.description: The commit the task's spec revision is pinned to.

path.description: The directory the session reads (`<environment root>/docs/<project_path>`).

project_path.description: The project folder in the workspace repo; `.` is the whole repo.

repo_id.description: The workspace repo the checkout is made from.

command.description: The Bash command; ignored for other tools.

path.description: Worktree-relative path of a file tool; always treated as inside the worktree.

command.description: One part of a compound command, without the redirects Saka accepts.

actor.description: The login of who asked for it, or `null` when Saka took it on its own.

author.description: The login of the pull request's author.

cause.description: `auto | comment | label | operator`: what made Saka take the pull request.

from_fork.description: The pull request comes from a fork of the repo.

oneOf.description: The spec step the pull request names; `null` means the review has no spec behind it.

ExternalChangeRequest.description: Request body that takes a pull request opened outside Saka and asks for its review.

number.description: The pull request number, 1 or more.

repo.description: The name of the repo binding in the project; `null` means the default repo.

step_id.description: `S1`, `S2`, ...; `null` when the pull request names the spec but no step that exists.

blob.description: Git blob sha of the file; also the strong `ETag`.

commit.description: Tip of the base branch the file was read at.

content.description: The exact file content (a leading BOM is U+FEFF; line endings are kept as they are).

blob.description: Git blob sha of the file at the tip.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace repo root.

FileTree.description: Markdown files of the project folder at the tip of the base branch.

commit.description: Tip of the base branch the list was read at.

files.description: Regular `.md`/`.markdown` files under the project folder, sorted by path bytes.

truncated.description: More than 5000 files exist; `files` holds the first 5000.

blob.description: Git blob sha of the file; also the strong `ETag`.

commit.description: The new commit, or the tip when the content was already there (`committed: false`).

committed.description: False when the content equals the file at the tip: no commit was made.

oneOf.description: The spec registered from this file in the same request, with its acceptance criteria.
Why the file was not registered as a spec, although it should have been.

FixBody.description: Request body of a fix request; no fields.

max_rounds.description: The rounds the workflow allows a task.

round.description: The highest round started. It passes `max_rounds` only when the operator granted another round after the limit.

required.description: Whether this source decides merge readiness under the repo's `[gate] source`.

context.description: What triggered the run: event, project, repo, task, spec, change, branch, sha, and blocker.

trigger.description: The event that triggered the run.

command.description: The shell command of a `run` or `run_host` hook.

cwd.description: The working directory of a `run_host` hook.

secret.description: The project secret that signs a `webhook` hook.

secrets.description: The project secrets a `run` hook receives.

url.description: The URL of a `webhook` hook without its query or fragment.

params.description: What the existing endpoint for the action needs: ids, a revision, or a task version.

action.description: The one primary action. It points at an endpoint that already exists; the inbox has none of its own.

dismissible.description: Only a spec approval can be dismissed.

params.description: What the item is about. Never holds a secret value.

running.description: Tasks that are in a stage now.

draft_path.description: The path of the spec draft whose session asked, for a permission that belongs to a draft.

spec_path.description: Where the spec lives in the docs, so a link can open it in the editor.

stage.description: The stage the task is at.

task_key.description: The task the item is about, when it is about one.

position.description: `0` when the task holds the turn, otherwise its place among those waiting, starting at `1`.

size.description: Tasks holding the turn plus tasks waiting for it.

text.description: 1 to 4000 characters; sent to the architect as the next turn.

command.description: Required for `Bash`, at most 2000 characters, matched against one part of a compound command; not allowed for other tools. An `allow` glob made only of `*` is refused as too broad.

path.description: Worktree-relative path, not allowed for `Bash`; omit to cover every path.

tool.description: 1 to 100 characters, the agent CLI's tool name (`Bash`, `Edit`, ...).

OperatorPermissionRule.description: A rule from the operator's `config.toml`; read-only here.

commands.description: Globs matched against one part of a Bash command; empty means any command.

paths.description: Globs relative to the worktree; empty means any path.

context.description: What triggered the run: event, project, repo, task, spec, change, branch, sha, and blocker.

trigger.description: The event that triggered the run.

action.description: The one primary action. It points at an endpoint that already exists; the inbox has none of its own.

dismissible.description: Only a spec approval can be dismissed.

params.description: What the item is about. Never holds a secret value.

authorship_mode.description: `bot | user | user_pat`: who authors the agent's commits and opens its pull requests.

hooks_skipped.description: Operator hooks that `[hooks] skip` in `saka.toml` turns off for this project.

repos.description: Bindings from `saka.toml`, the default first, then by `name`.

workflow.description: The workflow in force, from `[workflow]` in `saka.toml`.

oneOf.description: The revision that was approved; null before the first approval.

decisions.description: Decisions in the latest revision, in written order; empty in list items.

depends_on.description: Specs that must ship before this one starts, resolved in the project.

oneOf.description: Null unless the spec is approved and a newer revision is recorded.

items.description: A spec that the architect drafts from an idea, until Saka's lint passes and the file is committed.

oneOf.description: The latest attempt; `null` before the first admission.

available_actions.description: Subset of `retry`, `cancel`, and, while `awaiting_operator`, `message`, `commit` (only when the lint passes and no question is open) and `discard`.

oneOf.description: Use and limits of the running attempt; `null` when no attempt runs.

commit.description: The docs commit once `succeeded`, and for `failed` with `register_failed`.

oneOf.description: `{code, params}` while `failed`.

idea.description: As the operator wrote it; `null` in lists.

oneOf.description: The latest lint round of any attempt; `issues` is empty in lists.

mode.description: `draft` (the architect works alone and Saka commits the first passing file) or `session` (a conversation the operator commits).

path.description: The new spec file, from the repo root.

retries.description: Manual retries so far, at most 3.

oneOf.description: The latest session of the latest attempt.

slug.description: The file name without its extension.

state.description: `queued | preparing | drafting | awaiting_operator | committing | succeeded | failed | cancelled`

target_kind.description: `new` (a new spec file) or `revise` (an edit of the spec file that already exists).

waiting_on.description: Only while `queued`: an architect slot or an agent account window. Empty in action responses.

cost_usd.description: Decimal string in dollars, or `null` when the CLI did not report it.

autonomy.description:
`strict | standard | autonomous`: the level in force for the task's repo, the lowest of the
operator's ceiling and what `saka.toml` asks for. `null` in the answer to an action.

oneOf.description: Use and limits of the running stage run; `null` when no stage run with a session runs.

The docs pull request in the workspace repo, for a task in another repo; `null` when none
was opened. Gates and merge readiness never read it.
The latest environment of the task; `null` before one was prepared.
What is known about a pull request opened outside Saka; `null` for a task made from a spec step.
The latest fix round of the task; `null` before a round ran and when the workflow has no `fix` stage.

gates.description: Latest result per gate source for the current change request head, `scm` first.

merge_auto.description:
`true` when Saka will request the merge itself once review and checks pass: autonomy
`autonomous`, trigger `merge = "auto"`, and a review stage. `null` in the answer to an action.

oneOf.description:
Where the task's merge request stands in the queue of its target branch; `null` when it has
none, and in the answer to an action.

repo_name.description: Name of the binding of `repo_id` in the project now; `null` once a reload removed it.

oneOf.description: The newest reviewer verdict of the task; `null` before any review ran.

state.description: `queued | awaiting_start | admitted | in_stage | blocked | taken_over | done | cancelled | superseded`

waiting_on.description: Steps and specs this task still waits for; empty unless the task is queued.

PairedDevice.description: A device token. It is shown once and cannot be read again.

PairingCreated.description: A pairing code. Only the response that creates it carries `code`; a replay of the same request does not.

code.description: Ten characters of Crockford base32, valid once until `expires_at`.

PairingPurpose.description: What a pairing code is for. `setup` lets the first passkey be registered and is only issued to the local CLI; `passkey` registers another passkey; `token` pairs a client that holds a device token.

code.description: A `setup` or `passkey` pairing code. Not needed with a signed-in session.

name.description: A name for the passkey, 1 to 100 characters.

decisions.description: Decision requests still waiting for an answer.

permissions.description: Permission requests still waiting for an answer.

parts.description: Empty for a tool other than `Bash` and for a command that cannot be split safely.

changed.description: The requests whose answer would change if the rule existed.

scanned.description: How many of the project's latest task permission requests were re-judged (at most 200).

command.description: One part of a Bash command (see `match`); `null` for other tools.

match.description: `exact` compares text verbatim; `glob` is a glob (`*` does not cross `/` in `path`).

path.description: Worktree-relative path the rule applies to; `null` means every path.

permission_request_id.description: The request whose answer created the rule; `null` for a rule written by hand.

operator_rules.description: The operator's rules in evaluation order; they cap what a project rule can do.

fields.description: Changed fields in the order `work`, `ac`, `commands`, `after`, `repo`; only for `changed`.

count.description: Ports the recipe asked for, starting at `start`.

kind.description:
`retry | cancel | set_secret | link_account | set_user_token | edit_spec`. Only `retry` and
`cancel` run through `actions/primary`; the others need input the client collects.

action.description: The kind of the primary action the caller was shown (`primary_action.kind`). When it differs from the current one, nothing runs and the answer is `409 blocker_action_changed`.

blocker_id.description: The blocker the operator saw; a blocker that is no longer the open one of the task is refused.

authorship_mode.description: `bot | user | user_pat`: who authors the agent's commits and opens its pull requests.

hooks_skipped.description: Operator hooks that `[hooks] skip` in `saka.toml` turns off for this project.

repos.description: Bindings from `saka.toml`, the default first, then by `name`.

workflow.description: The workflow in force, from `[workflow]` in `saka.toml`.

ProjectAuthorship.description: Who authors a project's agent changes. Tokens are never part of it.

oneOf.description:
The identity the next session commits as, for the project's default repo; `null` when
the mode's credential is not usable.

integrations.description: The integrations of the repos bound to the project, each with its linked account state.

mode.description: `bot | user | user_pat`; `bot` for a project whose mode was never set.

mode_updated_at.description: When the mode last changed; `null` for a project whose mode was never set.

oneOf.description: The project's user token; `null` without one. Its value is never returned.

ProjectConfigError.description: The last rejected reload of `saka.toml`; the previous config stays in force while it is set.

base_branch.description: Branch this binding's worktrees, recipes, change requests, and merge checks use.

effective_path_scope.description: `path_scope`, plus `<project_path>/**` for the workspace repo unless `project_path` is `.`.

is_workspace.description: The repo is also the project's workspace repo.

ProjectUserToken.description: A stored user token, without its value.

expires_at.description: `null` for a token without an expiry.

ProjectWarning.description: A warning computed when the project is read; never stored.

status.description: As the CLI reports it, e.g. `allowed`, `allowed_warning`, `rejected`.

ReloadBody.description: Request body of a reload; no fields.

RemoteConfig.description: `saka.toml` at the tip of the workspace base branch.

commit.description: Commit at the tip of the base branch.

config_sha256.description: `sha256:<hex>` of the remote file; `null` when it is missing or larger than 65 536 bytes.

present.description: `false` when the file does not exist at that commit.

RepoAutonomy.description:
How much the loop may do on its own in this repo: the lowest of what the operator allows and what
`saka.toml` asks for.

allowed.description: The operator's ceiling for this repo, from `[autonomy]` in `config.toml`.

requested.description: `strict | standard | autonomous`, or `null` when `saka.toml` asks for nothing.

note.description: 1 to 4000 characters, sent to the architect in the packet of the new attempt.

stage.description: `dev`, `review`, `fix`, or `merge`: the stage the task re-enters. Empty means the stage it left when that is `dev` or `merge`, otherwise `dev`.

ReviewBody.description: Request body of a review request; no fields.

questions.description: What the reviewer could not judge; only for `spec_unclear`.

basis.description: `step | spec | none`; `none` means the reviewer judged without a spec.

current.description: The verdict judged the head the change request has now.

oneOf.description: Where the review was posted; `null` before it was posted and for `spec_unclear`.

context.description: Context documents pinned with this revision, in work packet order (`link` first, then `always`).

context_hash.description: `sha256:<hex>` over the resolved context references; part of the revision identity.

parser_version.description: Version of the parser that read this revision.

RevisionPlan.description: What approving the latest revision again would do to each step.

ready.description: No conflict, clean lint, and the current parser.

content_hash.description: `sha256:<hex>` over the raw bytes of the spec file.

source_commit.description: Commit of the workspace repo the revision was read at.

oneOf.description: A stage run of a task.
An attempt of a spec draft.

RunOwner.description: The run that owns a session, its permission requests, and its usage records.

SecretList.description: The secrets of a project, ordered by name. At most 200, so there is no paging.

SecretName.description: A project secret, by name only.

name.description: `^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$`, never a name Saka sets itself.

oneOf.description: The environment the session runs in; `null` when it no longer exists.

role.description: The stage of the owning run (`dev`, `review`, `fix`, `merge`, `sync`) or `architect` for a draft.

title.description: The task key, or the slug of the draft.

kind.description: `system | thought | message | action | output | permission | result | steer`

oneOf.description: `null` when the recipe asks for no ports or the environment is torn down.

toolchains.description: Toolchains on `PATH`; empty when the repo declares no versions.

SessionsReply.description: The sessions of one run, or the active sessions of every project when `active=true`.

SetAuthorshipBody.description: Request body that sets a project's authorship mode.

mode.description:
`bot` (Saka authors and opens pull requests), `user` (the linked account of every
integration of the project authors commits and opens pull requests) or `user_pat` (the
owner of the project's user token).

SetSecretBody.description: Body of `PUT /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/secrets/{name}`. The value is write-only: no response, event, or log carries it, and it cannot be read back.

value.description: 8 to 65536 bytes of UTF-8 without NUL. Shorter values are refused (`secret_too_short`) so output redaction always applies.

SetUserTokenBody.description: Request body that stores a project's user token. The value is write-only.

value.description:
A GitHub fine-grained personal access token (`github_pat_…`), 40 to 255 bytes of
printable ASCII without spaces. It needs read access to every repo of the project and
write access to their pull requests.

oneOf.description: The revision that was approved; null before the first approval.

decisions.description: Decisions in the latest revision, in written order; empty in list items.

depends_on.description: Specs that must ship before this one starts, resolved in the project.

oneOf.description: Null unless the spec is approved and a newer revision is recorded.

SpecDecision.description: One question from the spec's `## Decisions` section.

chosen.description: 1-based number of the checked option; null while the decision is open.

text.description: Markdown source after the checkbox, trimmed, at most 500 characters (cut with `…`).

spec_id.description: Null when no spec in the project has this slug.

SpecDraft.description: A spec that the architect drafts from an idea, until Saka's lint passes and the file is committed.

oneOf.description: The latest attempt; `null` before the first admission.

available_actions.description: Subset of `retry`, `cancel`, and, while `awaiting_operator`, `message`, `commit` (only when the lint passes and no question is open) and `discard`.

oneOf.description: Use and limits of the running attempt; `null` when no attempt runs.

commit.description: The docs commit once `succeeded`, and for `failed` with `register_failed`.

oneOf.description: `{code, params}` while `failed`.

idea.description: As the operator wrote it; `null` in lists.

oneOf.description: The latest lint round of any attempt; `issues` is empty in lists.

mode.description: `draft` (the architect works alone and Saka commits the first passing file) or `session` (a conversation the operator commits).

path.description: The new spec file, from the repo root.

retries.description: Manual retries so far, at most 3.

oneOf.description: The latest session of the latest attempt.

slug.description: The file name without its extension.

state.description: `queued | preparing | drafting | awaiting_operator | committing | succeeded | failed | cancelled`

target_kind.description: `new` (a new spec file) or `revise` (an edit of the spec file that already exists).

waiting_on.description: Only while `queued`: an architect slot or an agent account window. Empty in action responses.

base_sha.description: The base branch commit the attempt's environment was prepared at.

diff.description: Unified diff against the base commit, cut at 256 KiB.

SpecDraftChanges.description:
The latest file content the architect wrote.
What a session-mode draft changed in the docs checkout, with the lint result of its last turn.

files.description: Markdown files inside the project folder that differ from the base commit; empty once the checkout is gone.

passed.description: Whether the target file passed the lint after the last turn.

content.description: The bytes as written, as UTF-8 (line endings kept).

content_hash.description: `sha256:<hex>`; `null` when the file was missing or too large.

issues.description: Same shape as `Spec.lint.issues`, context issues included.

SpecDraftPacket.description: The packet of the latest attempt, as sent to the architect.

path.description: `null` for the template and the rules.

source.description: What the packet names the document by, for example `docs/prd.md @ <commit>`.

code.description: Same codes as registering a spec: `spec_slug_conflict`, `validation_failed`, `scm_unavailable`.

content.description: Markdown that parses without issues as `example-spec.md`.

round.description: The fix round the run belongs to; `null` for every other run.

StartUserLinkBody.description: Request body that starts linking an account; no fields.

text.description: 1 to 4000 characters, sent to the agent as a user message.

after.description: Step ids this step waits for.

repo.description: The `Repo` cell as written; null when the column is absent or the cell is empty (the project's default repo).

repo_id.description: Repo the step runs in: the task's repo once the step has a task, otherwise `repo` resolved against the project's current repos; null when the name is not bound to the project.

StreamEvent.description: One event of `GET /api/v1/events` (the `data` of an SSE message).

next_after.description: Offset of the last item when newer activities existed at read time; pass as `after`. `null` otherwise.

prev_before.description: Offset of the first item when older activities exist; pass as `before`. `null` otherwise.

cost_usd.description: Decimal string in dollars, or `null` when the CLI did not report it.

UserLink.description:
The SCM account linked to an integration, so that changes can be authored as its user.
Tokens are never part of it.

access_expires_at.description: When the user access token expires; it is refreshed before use.

email.description:
The noreply address `<id>+<login>@users.noreply.<host of web_url>`, used as the commit
author email.

name.description: The profile name, or `null` when the profile has none; commits then use `login`.

provider_user_id.description: The account id at the provider (`GET /user` `id`).

refresh_expires_at.description: When the refresh token expires; after it the account has to be linked again.

UserLinkAuthorization.description:
One device-flow attempt to link an account. The user opens `verification_uri` and enters
`user_code`; the server polls the provider every `interval_secs` until the attempt ends.

expires_at.description: After this time a pending attempt ends as `expired`.

oneOf.description:
Only with `failed`. `code`: `device_flow_disabled | incorrect_client_credentials |
incorrect_device_code | unsupported_grant_type | bad_verification_code |
token_not_expiring | identity_unavailable`.

interval_secs.description: Seconds between polls; raised when the provider asks to slow down.

oneOf.description: The linked account once `completed`, otherwise `null`.

user_code.description: The code the user enters at `verification_uri`, for example `WDJB-MJHT`.

oneOf.description: A step of the same spec that is not done yet.
A spec that has not shipped yet.
An agent account window at or above `agent.rate_limit_pause` that has not reset yet.
Every port block in `env.port_range` is held by a live environment.
Every architect slot (`architect.max_active`) is held by another draft.

autonomy.description:
`strict | standard | autonomous`: the level in force for the task's repo, the lowest of the
operator's ceiling and what `saka.toml` asks for. `null` in the answer to an action.

oneOf.description: Use and limits of the running stage run; `null` when no stage run with a session runs.

The docs pull request in the workspace repo, for a task in another repo; `null` when none
was opened. Gates and merge readiness never read it.
The latest environment of the task; `null` before one was prepared.
What is known about a pull request opened outside Saka; `null` for a task made from a spec step.
The latest fix round of the task; `null` before a round ran and when the workflow has no `fix` stage.

gates.description: Latest result per gate source for the current change request head, `scm` first.

merge_auto.description:
`true` when Saka will request the merge itself once review and checks pass: autonomy
`autonomous`, trigger `merge = "auto"`, and a review stage. `null` in the answer to an action.

oneOf.description:
Where the task's merge request stands in the queue of its target branch; `null` when it has
none, and in the answer to an action.

repo_name.description: Name of the binding of `repo_id` in the project now; `null` once a reload removed it.

oneOf.description: The newest reviewer verdict of the task; `null` before any review ran.

state.description: `queued | awaiting_start | admitted | in_stage | blocked | taken_over | done | cancelled | superseded`

waiting_on.description: Steps and specs this task still waits for; empty unless the task is queued.

reviews.description: Every verdict of the task, newest first.

oneOf.description:
Checkout of the project folder from the workspace repo; `null` when the task's repo is
the workspace repo.
`null` when the recipe asks for no ports or the environment is torn down.

recipe_sha256.description: SHA-256 of `.saka/environment.toml` at the base commit; `null` when the repo has no recipe.

toolchains.description: Toolchains on `PATH`; empty when the repo declares no versions.

environment_id.description: The `ready` environment whose ports, toolchains, and session secret names are in the packet.

revision_id.description: Revision the task is pinned to.

text.description: The first turn exactly as the session receives it, without a CI retry paragraph.

oneOf.description: The entry point for pull requests opened outside Saka; `null` when the workflow has none.

fix_rounds.description: How many fix rounds a task gets at most (`1..=10`); counts only when the workflow has a `fix` stage.

spec.description: Whether an approved spec creates tasks.

stages.description: The stages in pipeline order, each with its trigger.

authors.description: A pull request matches when its author is any of these logins; empty matches all.

branches.description: Glob patterns on the head branch name; empty matches all.

labels.description: A pull request matches when it carries any of these labels; empty matches all.

paths.description: Path patterns (`path_scope` syntax); a pull request matches when it touches one included path.

trigger_label.description: The label that asks for a review when the trigger is `manual`.

content.description: The exact new file content, at most 1 MiB as UTF-8.
